name: cyber_fox

emotion_styles.hope: hopeful cyberpunk skyline, golden digital dawn

stages.name: ネオンの夜
stages.description: 電脳都市に狐火が灯る
stages.prompt: high quality anime illustration, elegant fox spirit shrine maiden in a futuristic Japanese city, luminous foxfire, neon cyan and magenta, cinematic night

stages.name: 電脳神域
stages.description: 電子の鳥居が異界への道を開く
stages.prompt: anime cinematic illustration, holographic torii gates in a digital shrine, floating luminous symbols, sacred cyberpunk atmosphere

stages.name: 接続
stages.description: 狐火がネットワークを駆け巡る
stages.prompt: dynamic anime illustration, spectral foxfire traveling through glowing data streams, futuristic network visualization, dramatic composition

stages.name: 星界の旅
stages.description: 仮想世界が星の海へ変わる
stages.prompt: anime cinematic illustration, cyber fox spirit crossing a cosmic virtual landscape, star ocean, luminous blue and violet

stages.name: デジタル黎明
stages.description: 電子の世界に新しい朝が訪れる
stages.prompt: beautiful anime illustration, futuristic shrine above a city at sunrise, golden foxfire, hopeful digital dawn

character.description: the same recurring anime protagonist in the cyber fox world, with consistent face, hairstyle, outfit silhouette, age impression, and body proportions throughout the entire music video
consistency_rules: keep the same face and hairstyle across scenes
keep outfit design and color identity consistent unless the story explicitly changes them
keep age impression, body proportions, and character identity stable
do not introduce additional protagonists unless the lyrics or scene require them

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in cyberpunk city, rainy street, neon alley; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with neon blue, magenta, cyan, white; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by cinematic wide shot, drone city view, street-level neon reflection; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
